caption: Both groups start from the same pre-test mean of 40, so the maximum possible gain is 60 points for each. The AR group's 38-point rise normalises to 0.63 and the printed-notes group's 26-point rise to 0.43 — with 30 students per group this is a signal, not proof.

spec.title: Normalised gain, worked example
spec.aria: Block diagram of the worked example: a pre-test mean of 40 out of 100, giving a maximum gain of 60 points, splits into an AR group scoring 78 (raw rise 38, normalised gain 0.63) and a printed-notes group scoring 66 (raw rise 26, normalised gain 0.43).
